source_refs.note: i) Hypothesis: a main subheading of 14.12 Experiments and data collection to test a hypothesis about air quality, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 317-317.

blocks.text: Pehle step mein experiment design karne ke liye ek hypothesis banai jati hai. Misal: “Shehri ilaqon mein hawa ke particulate matter (PM 2.5) aur nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) ki concentration rush (peak) traffic ke hours mein baqi hours se zyada hoti hai.” Is hypothesis ko din ke different times par air quality ka data jama kar ke test kiya ja sakta hai.
